person.name: Devon Bull
person.title: Solutions Architect
person.introduction: I take software from architecture through delivery and support. My work includes a solo cloud-console migration for Apple and engineering leadership on Chick-fil-A delivery integrations.

work.title: Cloud Portal
work.contribution: Porting the Third Party Cloud Console into Portal and implementing an LLM chat interface.
highlights: Responsible for porting the Third Party Cloud Console into Portal.

work.title: A cloud console, rebuilt
work.contribution: Rebuilt an Angular application in React as the sole engineer, while adding features and supporting legacy applications.
highlights: Owned architecture, implementation, delivery, and ongoing support for legacy applications.
Ported the Angular application to React while adding new features.

caseStudy.heading: The assignment
paragraphs: Apple's Third Party Cloud Console needed to move from Angular to React. The migration ran alongside new feature work and ongoing support for legacy applications.

caseStudy.heading: My responsibility
paragraphs: I was the sole engineer responsible for the port. My ownership covered architecture, implementation, delivery, and ongoing support. This was an end-to-end engineering assignment rather than one component of a larger migration team.

caseStudy.heading: The constraint
paragraphs: The work was broader than replacing a frontend. New features still needed implementation, and legacy applications still needed support. Those responsibilities remained part of my remit throughout the migration.

caseStudy.heading: The technical direction
paragraphs: The confirmed technical direction was an Angular-to-React migration. I owned the architecture and implementation of that port. This account does not claim that I selected React, or that a particular rollout or state-management strategy was used.

caseStudy.heading: What followed
paragraphs: The cloud-console engagement ran from July 2022 through October 2024. My next assignment was porting the Third Party Cloud Console into Portal, where I also implemented an LLM chat interface.

caseStudy.heading: What this account can establish
paragraphs: The work demonstrates solo ownership across architecture, delivery, feature development, and support. This public account omits internal architecture, screenshots, and performance figures. It makes no quantified claim about the migration's business impact.

Improved service logging, monitoring, and observability.
